name: Veggie Ground, Olive & Feta-Stuffed Peppers with Cucumber-Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 orange bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, veggie ground, and spices; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop olives and sun-dried tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the veggie ground is done, add olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and half of the feta to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining feta for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Turn pepper halves cut-side up, stuff with the filling, then top with reserved feta. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil peppers until the cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
While the peppers are broiling, place yogurt, vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
